implemented: Original byte A range uses an initial canopy, bounded nonsymmetric Gram windows, and final retained children in the same MSB fraction tree.
SourceModel::range selects the new evaluator for the canonical A reader installed by canonical_state; W and sources without that reader still use previous paths.
The first complete initial byte scan caches 256 u64 counts including the external zero suffix. The range does not add a histogram reconstruction pass.
Malformed/incomplete/non-byte/failed initial scans do not install a source. Existing source uniqueness and immutability remain trusted producer contracts, not consequences of cardinality alone.

Fallible private evaluators reuse the existing fraction-tree authentication, Fiat-Shamir, product checks and terminal original-MAC forms. Reader errors stop before the next authentication, without scalar fallback.
Consumed canopy levels and Gram storage are dropped before successors; child Vec capacity after truncate remains live and is included in the evaluator's named payload count.
No new full D34 tree or Eq(N) vector; large allocations use try_reserve_exact. This remains CPU arithmetic and a partial resource ledger.
